criteria.correctness: Every worker must validate all per-column hashes, native types, row and column order and total rows in a separate untimed repeat; timed pass checks total rows.
criteria.cpu: Review any median CPU regression above10percent, not automatically hidden by elapsed speed or memory savings.
criteria.memory: The large-file prototype should lower median peak RSS by at least50percent to justify a material memory improvement. RSS includes mapped file pages and is not allocation count.
criteria.scope: Natural native parallelism on matching CPU backend. No build/tests run by this task during measurements. No caller retention; one consumer requests immediately after each owned frame is released. No universal weighted efficiency score.
